info.title: stagelint
info.description: Run commands like linters and formatters on staged git files

commands.name: help
commands.description: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Run all tasks to completion even if one fails, then report all errors together

options.name: --concurrent
options.description:
Run at most this many tasks at once, or false to run them sequentially
[default: true]

options.name: --max-arg-length
options.description:
Split a command into chunks when its arguments would exceed this length.
The length is in bytes, or UTF-16 characters on Windows, and is detected from the system unless given. Commands with `pass_filenames: false` are never split.

options.name: --diff
options.description:
Lint the files changed in a revision range instead of the staged files.
Takes any range `git diff` does - `main...HEAD` for everything on the branch since it diverged, or a single revision such as `HEAD~3` to compare against HEAD. Nothing is stashed and nothing is staged.

options.name: --unstaged
options.description:
Lint the files modified in the working tree, including untracked ones.
Nothing is stashed and nothing is staged.

options.name: --files
options.description: Lint the given paths instead of the staged files.

options.name: --all
options.description:
Lint every file in the working tree that is not ignored, instead of the staged files.
Tracked and untracked files are both linted. Symlinks, submodules, skip-worktree paths and files missing from the working tree are skipped. Nothing is stashed and nothing is staged.

options.name: --stash
options.description:
Control stash scope; each value includes the previous
Possible values:
- partial:   Only stash partially-staged files
- tracked:   Also stash dirty tracked files
- untracked: Also stash untracked files
[default: partial]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only the output of failed commands and errors

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show the output of every command, not only of those that failed
